description: Type in the players, get a knockout bracket, and share one link everyone follows as the rounds are played. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

draw.description: `seeded` treats the order given as the rankings: the first two can only meet in the final and byes go to the top. `shuffled` draws at random, which is what an office sweepstake wants. Either way the order is fixed once the bracket exists.

players.description: Everybody in the draw, 4 to 64. Any number works — one that is not a power of two gets byes in the first round, placed against the top seeds so no bye faces another and both halves play the same number of rounds. Names are compared case-insensitively, so the same name twice is refused as a typo.

items.description: One entrant's name, as it is shown.

title.description: The tournament's name, shown as the page heading. Up to 80 characters.
